The Mastermind course includes 500+ trade reviews and bonus lessons, daily watchlists and weekly newsletters, an automated key-levels TradingView indicator, and a personalized trading psychology tool.

course.refund_policy: No refunds, except under specific legal requirements or on a case-by-case basis at the company's discretion. No money-back guarantee is offered.

_notes.source: Founder (Jake Ricci) and lifetime price ($3,000) confirmed via WebSearch of multiple independent review sites; monthly price ($199) confirmed directly on the live Whop product page (one review source showed $175, which may be outdated - we went with the figure read directly from the current page). Refund policy confirmed via WebSearch summary of the provider's own store policies, quoted in our own words. No independently-confirmed official domain, so 'website' points to the Whop store. No Trustpilot profile found (raketrades.com 404s). 15% affiliate commission confirmed via whoptrends.com during our earlier shortlist research. Logo is the community's own wordmark from its Whop listing.
